findings.reason: the queue orders only what the plan declares, so the drain measure would begin on a batch path whose write-path and read-scope behaviour is still being rewritten, repeating exactly the wait the plan added for `s40`, `s41` and `s42`.

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — §43 cites `BatchPlanRead.write_paths`, a class that does not exist in the repository.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §43's four cases exercise only the literal description "the new test", so a phrase-specific implementation passes while the deliverable's general rule ("a file only by description") is left unheld.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — both sections write gate logs "under the run directory", a durable per-run path, not a session scratchpad or node-local temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test filename and the write-path symbols describe the mechanism (a batch entry carrying its done-when test), and no plan label, stage name or ticket number reaches them.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §43's root cause is confirmed at head (a sentence ending "and the new test" yields only the module token, so the entry is stored without the test), and §44's is confirmed too (`reckon/roadmap.py:27` binds `authored_section_headings` by name, so the wrapper assigned at `reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:178` never intercepts the roadmap's calls; `plan_document_text` at `reckon/crew/admission/readiness.py:273-295` is memoised only inside `plan_read_scopes`, so reverting it to a plain read is a coherent and falsifiable negative control). Neither section names a step sequence or a function to implement; the symbols it cites serve as root-cause evidence in the Why.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §43 delivers one stored-write-path rule and one negative control; §44 delivers one endpoint (every saving the read scope's docstrings claim is made by the code and held by a test), with its two claimed savings as instances of that single goal.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §43 and §44 are declared `implementable` but `s14`'s `plan-section-depends-on` list (plan.html:22) still ends at `#s42`, while §14's own text (plan.html:104) says the drain starts "Once every other section has landed".
